seoDescription: Summit Asset Management is a fee-only, 100% employee-owned investment advisory firm in Memphis, Tennessee, founded in 1991.
heading: Deep roots. Independent perspective.
intro: Summit Asset Management has been providing investment services and financial advice since 1991.
imageAlt: Clark Centre in Memphis, home of Summit’s office
paragraphs: We have deep roots that have connected us to the community and the financial services industry for generations. Accordingly, we know the importance of lasting relationships. Our vision is to continue that legacy and that same commitment to people in everything we do.
Summit is 100% employee owned. There’s no pressure from outside owners that might conflict with clients’ interests.
attributesLink: Founded 1991, mid-sized, independent and fee-only: the attributes that shape how we work.
historyLink: From Frank A. Jones’s founding of Summit to the firm today.
